As of May 2026( there are 53 sites (14 natural and 39 cultural) on the List of World Heritage in Danger. Arranged by UNESCO regions, 22 of the listed sites are in the Arab States, 12 in Africa, six in Latin America and the Caribbean, six in Asia and the Pacific, and seven in Europe and North America. The majority of the endangered natural sites (nine) are in Africa. results.content:
Endangered HeritageThis is a list intended to inform the international community about serious threats to the value of World Heritage sites and to encourage conservation support. Following the 48th World Heritage Committee meeting (July 2026, Busan), six sites were added to the list and one was removed.There are a total of 58 sites designated as World Heritage in Danger.The main developments this time were three new listings added simultaneously through emergency procedures, three additions [...] What's important is,Even if it is removed from the List of World Heritage in Danger, it will still remain a World Heritage Site.That's the point. Lifting the alert means that "progress has been made in responding to the threat," but it doesn't mean that future monitoring will no longer be necessary.

## List of World Heritage in Danger (58 sites in total, as of July 2026) [...] ## Six sites that will be added to the List of World Heritage in Danger in 2026

At the 48th World Heritage Committee meeting,Six sites have been newly added to the List of World Heritage in Danger.Three of these sites were inscribed as World Heritage Sites through emergency procedures and simultaneously placed on the List of World Heritage in Danger (see:UNESCO announcement).
